Spring forward with the amazing Pokémon TCG: Collector Chest! This sturdy metal case contains more than a dozen special Pokémon goodies, including many not found anywhere else. You'll even find three promo cards featuring the first partner Pokémon of the Alola region: Rowlet, Litten, and Popplio!

• 5 Pokémon TCG booster packs
• 3 foil promo cards featuring Rowlet, Litten, and Popplio
• A cool Pokémon coin
• 2 colorful sticker sheets

• A Pokémon notepad and 4 pencils
• A code card for the Pokémon TCG Online
